articles.title: UP Silicon Valley plan: In next 24 months, Yogi govt will build Rs 281 crore Deep Tech U-Hub in Noida to help innovators turn ideas into reality
articles.description: The Uttar Pradesh Cabinet, chaired by Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, has approved a Rs 281.03 crore Deep Tech U-Hub at IIT Kanpur's Noida campus, with completion targeted in 24 months. The Cabinet also cleared proposals covering regional airport connectivity, a new stadium in Agra, a cooperative college in Lucknow, financial assistance for women and child victims, and amendments to tourism and bio-energy policies.

articles.title: Noel Tata to push alternative plan at Tata Sons board meeting
articles.description: Noel Tata plans to present an alternative restructuring proposal for Tata Sons at the November 26 board meeting. The Tata Trusts are also advocating for changes to preserve Tata Sons' unlisted status through mergers. A legal opinion has suggested compliance with RBI is necessary, complicating the situation.

articles.title: LiberNovo’s Black Friday sale takes up to 42% off ergonomic chairs
articles.description: You can spend plenty of time getting your Mac, display, and desk just right. But what about the chair you use every day? Between typing, taking video calls, and leaning back to watch something, your position changes throughout the day. Your chair should be able to keep up. That’s the idea behind LiberNovo’s ergonomic chairs, which combine support that moves with you and a choice of sizes, including the Maxis range for bigger and taller users. For Black Friday, LiberNovo is taking up to 42% off in the U.S., with chairs starting at $609 and offers running November 19–30. more…

articles.title: JPMorgan, Visa, Mastercard hit by cyber incidents; data of thousands of customers leaked
articles.description: JPMorgan Chase, Visa, and Mastercard have encountered cyber incidents with third-party service providers, leading to the potential exposure of customer data. Fortunately, these breaches did not compromise any payment systems or card details. Investigations are currently underway, with affected customers being notified directly by their financial institutions. This situation amplifies concerns regarding the security of data entrusted to external vendors, prompting regulatory inquiries into these matters.

articles.title: GTA 6 Launch: Germany Pays Workers To Play As $1 Billion Game Faces Labour Backlash And AI Threat
articles.description: GTA 6 has arrived with record-breaking hype, around 10 million pre-orders and production costs estimated at more than $1 billion. In Germany, some workers can even use paid educational leave to attend a three-day GTA 6 course featuring expert talks, workshops and gaming sessions. But behind the blockbuster launch lies a troubled video-game industry. Thousands of developers have lost their jobs since 2022, while Rockstar Games has faced criticism over long working hours, employee surveillance and alleged anti-union practices. As GTA 6 developers push for union recognition, the game’s launch also raises a bigger question: could artificial intelligence make massive, decade-long video-game projects a thing of the past?

articles.title: Apple outranks Walmart and Amazon on efforts to curb toxic chemicals in products and packaging
articles.description: Most companies are backsliding when it comes to consumer safety, but Apple bucked the trend in a new review that found nearly half of the retailers reassessed lost ground on toxic chemicals and plastics. Apple earned the highest score and the only A in Toxic-Free Future's 2026 Retailer Report Card. The average grade across 50 major retailers in the United States and Canada remained a D+. IKEA, Target, and Sephora followed Apple with A- grades. The report evaluates how retailers disclose and address hazardous chemicals and plastics in their products, packaging, and supply chains.
